name: Alertly
tagline: Get notified only of important notifications.
blurb: This Android application is designed to improve user experience by filtering and highlighting important notifications amongst spam.
description: This Android application is designed to improve user experience by filtering and highlighting important notifications amongst spam. The app scans incoming notifications for a user-defined keyword. Its primary goal is to help users by ensuring they never miss crucial information!
